text: U.S. stock markets traded mixed on Monday, August 24, 2026, as a decline in technology shares—driven by volatility in semiconductor stocks—offset gains in blue-chip indices. While the Dow Jones Industrial Average edged higher, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite faced downward pressure as investors rotated into defensive sectors like consumer staples, financials, and utilities amid uncertainty regarding upcoming U.S. sanctions against Iran and anticipation of this week's Jackson Hole Economic Symposium. Technology, energy, and industrial stocks lagged during the session, with semiconductor companies weighing heavily on the broader market ahead of Nvidia's highly anticipated earnings report.
